#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

static long long binom[61][61];
static int numA[61], numB[61];
static long long minDiff;
static string seq;
static map<string, long long> memo;
static int rows, cols;

long long getLong() {
    long long val = 0;
    bool negative = false;
    int ch;
    bool seenDigit = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (ch == '-') {
            seenDigit = true;
            negative = true;
            continue;
        } else if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
            seenDigit = true;
            val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
        } else if (seenDigit) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return negative ? -val : val;
}

int getInteger() {
    return (int)getLong();
}

string getWord() {
    string sb;
    int ch;
    bool started = false;
    while ((ch = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (isalnum(ch) || ch == '?') {
            started = true;
            sb += (char)ch;
        } else if (started) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return sb;
}

void explore(long long aSum, long long bSum, int idx1, int idx2) {
    long long diff = llabs(aSum - bSum);
    if (minDiff <= 1 || diff - binom[idx1][rows] * binom[idx2][rows] >= minDiff) return;
    if (idx1 == rows - 1 && idx2 == rows - 1) {
        if (diff < minDiff) minDiff = diff;
        return;
    }
    if (idx1 >= rows) {
        long long diff1 = binom[idx1][rows] - binom[idx1 - 1][rows];
        long long factor = binom[idx2][rows];
        explore(aSum, bSum + diff1 * factor, idx1 - 1, idx2);
    }
    if (idx2 >= rows) {
        long long diff2 = binom[idx2][rows] - binom[idx2 - 1][rows];
        long long factor = binom[idx1][rows];
        explore(aSum + diff2 * factor, bSum, idx1, idx2 - 1);
    }
}

long long search(long long aSum, long long bSum, int idx1, int idx2) {
    long long diff = llabs(aSum - bSum);
    if (diff - binom[idx1][rows] * binom[idx2][rows] > minDiff) return 0LL;
    string key = to_string(aSum) + "," + to_string(idx1) + "," + to_string(idx2);
    if (memo.find(key) != memo.end()) return memo[key];
    if (idx1 < rows || idx2 < rows) {
        if (idx1 >= numA[idx1 + idx2] && idx2 >= numB[idx1 + idx2]) {
            int sum = idx1 + idx2;
            idx1 -= numA[sum];
            idx2 -= numB[sum];
            return binom[idx1 + idx2][idx1];
        }
        return 0LL;
    }
    long long ways = 0LL;
    char token = seq[idx1 + idx2 - 1];
    if (token != 'B') {
        long long diff1 = binom[idx1][rows] - binom[idx1 - 1][rows];
        long long factor = binom[idx2][rows];
        ways += search(aSum, bSum + diff1 * factor, idx1 - 1, idx2);
    }
    if (token != 'A') {
        long long diff2 = binom[idx2][rows] - binom[idx2 - 1][rows];
        long long factor = binom[idx1][rows];
        ways += search(aSum + diff2 * factor, bSum, idx1, idx2 - 1);
    }
    memo[key] = ways;
    return ways;
}

void run() {
    rows = getInteger();
    cols = getInteger();
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) binom[i][j] = 1;
            else binom[i][j] = binom[i - 1][j - 1] + binom[i - 1][j];
        }
    }
    long long left = 0, right = 0;
    int p1 = rows + cols, p2 = rows + cols;
    while (p1 >= rows && p2 >= rows) {
        if (left > right) {
            long long diff1 = binom[p1][rows] - binom[p1 - 1][rows];
            long long factor = binom[p2][rows];
            right += diff1 * factor;
            p1--;
        } else {
            long long diff2 = binom[p2][rows] - binom[p2 - 1][rows];
            long long factor = binom[p1][rows];
            left += diff2 * factor;
            p2--;
        }
    }
    minDiff = llabs(left - right);
    explore(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
    seq = getWord();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (rows + cols); i++) {
        numA[i + 1] = numA[i] + (seq[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        numB[i + 1] = numB[i] + (seq[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    memo.clear();
    long long count = search(0, 0, rows + cols, rows + cols);
    cout << count << endl;
}

int main() {
    run();
    return 0;
}
